items.title: Shahadah
items.subtitle: Declaration of faith
items.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
items.body: The Shahadah is the testimony that there is no god worthy of worship except Allah, and that Muhammad ﷺ is His Messenger. It is the foundation of Islam and the key to entering the faith.

items.title: Salah
items.subtitle: Prayer
items.body: Salah is the five daily prayers performed at prescribed times. It connects the believer with Allah, disciplines the soul, and is the second pillar of Islam.

items.title: Zakat
items.subtitle: Obligatory charity
items.body: Zakat is the annual giving of a fixed portion of qualifying wealth to those in need. It purifies wealth, supports the community, and expresses gratitude to Allah.

items.title: Sawm
items.subtitle: Fasting
items.body: Sawm is fasting during the month of Ramadan from dawn until sunset. It builds taqwa, empathy for the needy, and self-restraint.

items.title: Hajj
items.subtitle: Pilgrimage
items.body: Hajj is the pilgrimage to Makkah once in a lifetime for those who are able. It unites the Ummah and commemorates the legacy of Ibrahim (AS) and his family.
